Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and lots of context on FinTechCo's latency-sensitive use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap:
  - Primary workload: real-time risk scoring API called from loan origination flow (~150ms SLA target).
  - Expected qps: 400 requests/sec in peak window, average 120 rps off-peak.
  - Payload: short inputs (200-400 tokens), with occasional longer batch evals.
  - Privacy: PII in prompts; customer needs VPC/private deployment and KMS integration.

- Next steps:
  1) Schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on throughput / latency targets and admin/network requirements. Marissa (cc'd) will drive the sizing discussion and recommend pod sizes.
  2) Share a short capacity template; we'll fill initial recommendations ahead of the call.

I've attached a capacity template and our Dedicated primer for reference. Please let me know 2–3 windows that work next week; Marissa's availability is below.

Marissa availability (PDT): Tue 6/8 10:00–12:00, Wed 6/9 13:00–16:00, Thu 6/10 09:00–11:00.

Thanks,
David
